messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Quality regression detected for tenant acme-health in dedicated pool rp-dedicated-34. Model=open-llama-13b, quant_profile=q4_0_v2. 20%+ p50 drop vs baseline over last 15m. Auto-alert triggered.
Anna (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm handling.
Anna (oncall): Quick check — is this only generation quality or latency too?
Sam (eng-sre): Latency fine, no CPU/GPU throttles. GPU util steady at ~65%. Errors 0.
Priya (ml-eng): Looks like token-level perplexity spike on the tenant-specific prompt set. Likely quantization profile mismatch after last rollout.
Jorge (customer-ops): Confirming impact with acme-health. They see hallucinations in their medical-summary flow. High severity for them.
Maya (acct mgr): They're on a compliance window today. Wants ETA and potential rollback.
Anna (oncall): Sending plan: 1) Isolate tenant routing to standby pool if possible, 2) Revert quant_profile for that tenant to q4_0_v1 (last-known-good), 3) Run golden prompt regression checks, 4) Notify customer.
Sam (eng-sre): We can pin tenant routing to rp-dedicated-34-standby. I'll patch routing policy now.
Sam (eng-sre): Patch applied: `route update --tenant acme-health --pool rp-dedicated-34-standby`
Sam (eng-sre): Verified traffic shift at the LB: acme-health -> standby pool (approx 95% after draining).
Priya (ml-eng): Preparing revert command. Reverting quant profile only for tenant to avoid global impact.
Priya (ml-eng): Command: ```
rictl model revert-profile --tenant acme-health --model open-llama-13b --from q4_0_v2 --to q4_0_v1 --reason "regression: hallucinations on medical-summary" 
```
Anna (oncall): Go for it Priya. Post any errors here.
Priya (ml-eng): Running revert...
Priya (ml-eng): Revert started (job id rj-2026-03-15-001). Applying profile to 2 model instances.
Priya (ml-eng): Revert complete. Instances restarted.
Sam (eng-sre): Restart logs show clean starts. Health checks green.
Priya (ml-eng): Running golden prompt check suite (subset for medical-summary): 12/12 pass thresholds restored. p50 back to baseline.
Jorge (customer-ops): Acme-health confirms receiving improved output on their side. They asked what caused it.
Anna (oncall): Root cause preliminary: q4_0_v2 introduced a kernel-level rounding path that, for this tenant's prompt distribution, produced divergence in rare token generation. It passed platform-level tests but failed this tenant's narrow prompt set.
Maya (acct mgr): Customer is satisfied for now but wants a written incident note and assurance this won't recur.
Priya (ml-eng): Action items: 1) Pin acme-health to q4_0_v1 until we add their prompt set to the regression harness, 2) Add targeted tests for medical-summary prompts to the CI evals, 3) Roll forward a patched q4_0_v2' after extra checks.
Anna (oncall): Setting incident status: mitigated. Preparing handoff to weekday oncall.
Sam (eng-sre): Leaving a quick runbook snippet in case of reoccurrence: ```
# Reproduce and revert
1. `route update --tenant acme-health --pool rp-dedicated-34-standby`
2. `rictl model revert-profile --tenant acme-health --model open-llama-13b --from q4_0_v2 --to q4_0_v1`
3. `rictl eval run --suite golden-medical-summary --tenant acme-health`
```
Anna (oncall): Handoff to oncall-weekday: I've mitigated, revert applied, customer confirmed. Leaving incident tag and timeline in ops channel.
Maya (acct mgr): I'll follow up with a customer-facing summary and coordinate a retrospective next week.
Priya (ml-eng): Will add the tenant's prompt set to regression harness and add a gating check before any future quant_profile rollouts.
Jorge (customer-ops): Thanks team. Logging the incident on the customer's ticket: INC-ACME-4521.
Anna (oncall): Closing thread here. If anything else pops up, ping me or escalate to eng-ml. :thumbsup:
